title: Self-constructing node and waterfall
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for stateless contract-hydrated worker nodes, continuous per-step state profiling, keyword-triggered fresh resource hydration, weighted deterministic-to-harness waterfalls, multi-persona vector ratings and capability-gap spinout proposals.
boundaries: Workers remain stateless claimants of Tessera verbs and never create a rival task, scheduler or policy authority.
Unserved-signature spinout proposals stay in proposed_verbs and require distinct-reviewer verification before block admission.
Deterministic cache, keyword hydration and typed code blocks always run before model or CLI harness rungs when applicable.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for stateless contract-hydrated worker nodes, weighted deterministic-to-harness waterfalls, multi-persona vector scoring and capability-gap spinout proposals

value.lets_workers: Hydrate stateless worker nodes from operating, waterfall, behavior and output contracts, interrogate envelopes via 5W1H plus temporal horizon, short-circuit solved states via ContinuousStepProfiler, pull recently updated (< 6h) context via deterministic keyword triggers, explore K strategies (reuse, compose, modify, build_new) across a five-rung deterministic-to-CLI-harness waterfall (opencode, pi, codex), score outputs across five stakeholder personas and six vector dimensions and propose background capability-builder verbs when repeated unserved query shapes hit quorum.

flow.when: Decompose an input envelope across 5W1H plus temporal horizon, compute exact and shape hashes, short-circuit solved states and hydrate fresh (< 6h) external resources from keyword triggers.
Explore K candidate strategies (reuse, compose, modify, build_new) and execute the lowest-cost admissible rung across deterministic code blocks, hybrid synthesis or isolated CLI harness cells.
Score candidate outputs across five stakeholder personas and six vector dimensions, propose cheaper deterministic distillations and emit background capability-builder verb proposals at quorum.

value.worked_example: Synthetic 10-envelope multi-tier intelligence workload recomputed in test_constructible_node.py: executes point lookup, exact-signature cache short-circuit (0 tokens), <6h keyword-hydrated cohort quantile, negative-exclusion appetite and peer-actor matching (0 excluded leaks), multi-epoch OLS slope, minimal pi harness delegation and 3 repeated unserved cross_shock_elasticity queries in an opencode cell that trigger 1 capability-spinout proposal and accelerate the 4th query to rung_2_typed_code_blocks in 0 tokens, while passing AST and domain-agnostic naming gates.

nouns.category_reason: Prevents LLM-only token waste on repeatable lookups, cohort statistics, exclusions and already-solved intermediate states.

value.rule: Unless an envelope explicitly requests minimal_cli_harness_delegate, WeightedWaterfallExecutor probes Rung 0 exact cache, Rung 1 keyword fresh context and Rung 2 typed code blocks before Rung 3 hybrid or Rung 4 CLI harness cells.
value.how_it_is_checked: test_constructible_node.py verifies 5 zero-token executions across cache reuse, cohort quantiles, OLS trends and post-spinout block reuse.

value.exact_short_circuit: Canonical SHA-256 over intent_kind, entity_id, cohort_id, normalized query_text and sorted negative_tags returns cached verified output at Rung 0 in 0 tokens.
value.fresh_keyword_hydration: Keyword matches on resources updated within fresh_resource_max_age_hours (6.0h) inject live calibration multipliers prior to block execution.

value.name: self-constructing node and waterfall
